# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_BEARISH_BOS_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon is bearishly stacked (price below 8EMA, 21EMA, 55EMA) and a market-structure lower-low (BOS) forms with a bearish candle close, a short entry captures continuation. This edge exists because bearish ribbon alignment indicates sustained downtrend momentum, and a confirmed BOS with bearish close signals institutional selling pressure, increasing the probability of further downside before mean reversion or structural invalidation.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** When price is below the 8EMA, 21EMA, and 55EMA (bearish ribbon) AND a new lower low is formed (market structure BOS down) AND the bar that makes that low closes bearish (close < open) AND volume exceeds the 20-period average volume, enter short at the close of that bar.  
**Exit:** Chart-stop at recent higher high (structure invalidation), TP1 at 1R, runner trail using premium-stop 15% of ATR.  
**Regime filters:** Only active when price is below 200EMA or VWAP is below 200EMA (downtrend regime), ATR > its 20-period average (elevated volatility), and VIX > 20. Avoid entries when ATR is below its 20-period average (sideways/chop).
